columns.expression:
(case
      when "operation" = 'MODEL_TRY_ON'
        then 'model:' || coalesce("parameters"->>'modelProfileId', 'missing')
      when "operation" = 'EDITORIAL_MODEL'
        then 'parent:' || coalesce("parameters"->>'parentGenerationId', 'missing')
      else 'base'
    end)
